English: Scriptorium
A humble tent with rough benches and wax tablets, where rudimentary records are copied and guarded by the lords steward.
Book Alcove
A wooden lean-to with a locked chest, holding a handful of precious scrolls and books, offering a quiet space for study.
Manuscript Room
A sturdy timber room within the keep, containing several locked cupboards of manuscripts and a bench for local scribes.
Scriptorium Library
A robust stone chamber with reinforced doors, holding shelves of manuscripts and a small team of scribes at work.
Cleric Archive
A fortified chamber beneath the keep, with fireproof chests and clerks maintaining the lords archives and feudal records.
Scholars Library
A grand hall lined with bookshelves, reading desks, and a scriptorium for visiting scholars, fostering learning and administration.
Illuminators' Hall
A lavishly decorated hall employing skilled illuminators, producing ornate charters and attracting renowned minds.
Monastic Library
A fortified annex staffed by scholarly brothers, housing rare tomes and providing a hub for administration and record-keeping.
Cathedral Archive
A grand stone vault adjoining the castle, with iron-bound doors and a staff of learned archivists, preserving knowledge for generations.
Royal Library
A legendary institution within the castle, richly endowed and known throughout the realm, where scholars, scribes, and lords gather to shape the kingdoms destiny.
